steps.note: Open an existing event suitable for QCS inspection.
Open the quote comparison sheet where the target columns are displayed.
Verify the Hide Fields control offers all three columns to hide.
Reopen the field visibility menu before hiding GST.
Assert GST is no longer shown in the QCS.
Reopen the field visibility menu before hiding Quantity.
Assert Quantity is no longer shown in the QCS.
Reopen the field visibility menu before hiding Delivery Terms.
Assert Delivery Terms is no longer shown in the QCS.
Assert another QCS column remains visible.
